from IQData.entry import get_entry
from IQData.enumerate import MethodType as method


def initialize(context):
    # 初始化此策略
    # 设置我们要操作的股票池, 这里我们只操作一支股票
    pass
    
#当五日均线高于十日均线时买入，当五日均线低于十日均线时卖出
def handle_data(context, data):
    
    entry = get_entry()
    
    # 获取所有事件类型
    params = {
    }
    df = entry.api.get_method_data(method.EVENT_TYPE, **params)
    print(df)
    print("==========> 0")
    
    # 根据证券代码获取指定类型事件列表
    params = {
        "stockCode": '600570',
        "startDate": '2019-05-20',
        "endDate": '2019-05-30',
        "eventType": '2006003',
    }
    df = entry.api.get_method_data(method.EVENT_DATE, **params)
    print(df)
    print("==========> 1")
    
    # 查询指定时间范围内指定事件相关的证券列表
    params = {
        "stockCode": '600570',
        "startDate": '2019-05-20',
        "endDate": '2019-05-30',
        "eventType": '2006003',
    }
    df = entry.api.get_method_data(method.EVENT_PEROID, **params)
    print(df)
    print("==========> 2")
    
    # 获取指定证券某类型事件发生次数
    params = {
        "stockCode": '600570',
        "startDate": '2019-05-20',
        "endDate": '2019-05-30',
        "eventType": '2006003',
    }
    df = entry.api.get_method_data(method.EVENT_COUNT, **params)
    print(df)
    print("==========> 3")
    
    # 获取指定时间范围内某类型事件相关的证券
    params = {
        "startDate": '2019-05-20',
        "endDate": '2019-05-30',
        "eventType": '2006003',
    }
    df = entry.api.get_method_data(method.EVENT_SECURITY, **params)
    print(df)
    print("==========> 4")
    
    # 获取热点事件相关的证券
    params = {
        "endDate": '2019-05-30',
    }
    df = entry.api.get_method_data(method.EVENT_TOP, **params)
    print(df)
    print("==========> 5")
    
    # 获取指定时间范围内正面事件总数
    params = {
        "stockCode": '600570',
        "startDate": '2019-05-20',
        "endDate": '2019-05-30',
    }
    df = entry.api.get_method_data(method.EVENT_POEVENT, **params)
    print(df)
    print("==========> 6")
    
    # 获取指定时间范围内负面事件总数
    params = {
        "stockCode": '600570',
        "startDate": '2019-05-20',
        "endDate": '2019-05-30',
    }
    df = entry.api.get_method_data(method.EVENT_NGEVENT, **params)
    print(df)
    print("==========> 8")
    
    # 获取公司上下游信息(行业)
    params = {
        "companyName": '高新兴科技集团股份有限公司',
    }
    df = entry.api.get_method_data(method.KG_INDUSTRY_CHAIN, **params)
    print(df)
    print("==========> 9")
    
    # 获取公司上下游信息(产品)
    params = {
        "companyName": '信达投资有限公司',
    }
    df = entry.api.get_method_data(method.KG_PRODUCT_INDUSTRY_CHAIN, **params)
    print(df)
    print("==========> 10")
    
    # 根据证券代码获取指定类型事件列表
    params = {
        "companyName": '信达投资有限公司',
    }
    df = entry.api.get_method_data(method.KG_COMPANY_SHARE, **params)
    print(df)
    print("==========> 11")
    
    
    print("==========> end")
    
    # 获取
